## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List checks run and results. Distinguish lint/build/unit checks from browser and live Home Assistant verification. Include tested versions for frontend changes.

## Compatibility and configuration

Describe changed options or migration steps, or write “None”.

- [ ] Existing valid YAML and the card type remain compatible, or a migration is documented.
- [ ] Relevant phone/tablet/desktop, light/dark, Masonry/Sections behavior was checked, or the limits are stated.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials or sensitive deployment information are included.
